note:
Two medical explainer diagrams for /pages/skin-repair-renewal. Malcolm, 2026-08-25: professional medical-beauty explainer diagrams for 'What Slows Skin Repair?' and 'The Renewal Approach', in the style of the Matrixyl explainer set.

STYLE INHERITED FROM THE LIVE MATRIXYL SET, UNCHANGED: layered skin cross-section with three legible strata, seen from a low three-quarter angle; smooth glossy CGI, luminous and dreamy; high-key pale hazy gradient ground; tissue a soft desaturated peach-cream; actives as translucent spheres held above the surface; explicit downward delivery as SHAFTS OF LIGHT, never arrows; starburst glints at the point of arrival. The viewer must recognise the place before they read the event — that was the r3 lesson, and it is the reason rounds 1 and 2 of the copper-peptide set drifted into material studies.

MECHANISM FIRST, AND THE TWO PICTURES MUST NOT BE INTERCHANGEABLE. This is the discipline that mattered most on the copper-peptide and Matrixyl sets, and here it decides almost everything:

  causes    is the DEFICIT STATE. Nothing is being applied, so it carries NO spheres, NO light shafts and NO starburst glints — the whole delivery vocabulary is absent, deliberately. Its four faults are the four the copy names, each placed in the stratum it actually belongs to: slower renewal in the outer layer, environmental stress arriving from above and settling on it, loss of firmness in the deep fibre zone, and reduced resilience as the surface sagging into the slack beneath it.

  approach  is the SUPPORTED STATE, and it is the only one of the two that gets the delivery vocabulary. It also has to carry the copy's actual argument, which is a NEGATIVE one: renewal-focused skincare supports the skin's own processes RATHER THAN forcing turnover through chemical exfoliation, 'which can thin the skin'. So the outer layer is explicitly whole, even and unbroken, and peeling, flaking, dissolving and scrub particles are all negated by name. A picture that stripped the surface would illustrate the thing the paragraph argues against.

TWO ACTIVES, TWO DEVICES, TWO DESTINATIONS — because this page is not a single-ingredient page. PDRN and GHK-Cu are both named in the copy, they are different molecules, and they are shown doing different things in different strata:
  PDRN    a short FLAT ladder of paired pearl beads, two parallel rows joined by fine rungs. Polynucleotide, which is what PDRN is. Its shafts reach the BOTTOM ROW OF THE CELL STACK — the renewal layer.
  GHK-Cu  a chain of three beads with the middle one polished copper B87333. A tripeptide carrying a metal, which is what GHK-Cu is. Its shafts reach the DEEP FIBRE ZONE, where firmness lives.
That also puts the brand's signature device, the peptide chain, inside both actives while keeping them told apart at a glance.

THE LADDER MUST NOT TWIST. A polynucleotide drawn as a spiral becomes the DNA-double-helix stock cliché the whole set has negated from the start, and it stops reading as an ingredient. It is described as flat, with the twist negated by name.

COLOUR: Clinical blue 014EB1, which is this concern's ground colour in the concern-to-colour map (Skin Repair & Renewal, lead ingredient GHK-Cu), exactly as Teal is Matrixyl's. Tissue stays the desaturated peach-cream established in r3 — anatomy, not a brand colour, and held well back from PDRN's saturated blush. Teal and turquoise are negated so this never blurs into the Matrixyl page, the mirror of the Matrixyl brief negating copper and gold.

AGEING IS NOT INJURY. `causes` describes an ageing complexion, not a damaged one, so wound, lesion, redness, inflammation, scab and burn are negated. The store makes appearance claims and the picture must not out-claim the copy.

Both blocks currently wear borrowed photographs — a cream texture swirl and a stock turquoise laboratory scene, neither of which explains anything. Square 2048x2048, matching the measured render box (661x644 and 661x660 at 1440) and the Matrixyl blocks. CLASS B, no references attached, FLUX.2 and Luma both in the run.

slots.title: causes · the deficit state — nothing arriving, four faults in their own strata
slots.prompt:
Soft three-dimensional medical explainer illustration in the style of premium skincare advertising: smooth glossy CGI, luminous and dreamy, high-key on a pale hazy gradient background. Square format.

A block of skin is shown in cross-section, seen from a low three-quarter angle so both its top surface and its cut face are visible, occupying the lower two thirds of the frame. Three strata are legible from top to bottom: a thin outer layer with a texture of soft interlocking plates; beneath it a stack of flattened rounded translucent cells; and below that an open deeper zone filled with long wavy bundles of glossy fibre running horizontally. The tissue is a soft desaturated peach-cream, warm and pale. The fibre bundles are a clear vivid blue, colour hex 014EB1, glassy and translucent against the warm tissue.

NOTHING IS BEING APPLIED TO THIS BLOCK. The air above it is empty and hazy, with no spheres, no beads, no beams of light and no bright glints anywhere in the picture.

FOUR THINGS ARE VISIBLY WRONG, each in its own layer. FIRST, the outer layer is too thick and disordered: its plates are piled up in overlapping drifts several deep, their edges lifting slightly, the whole surface dull and matte rather than clear, as though they have stayed far too long. SECOND, fine dark grey specks drift slowly down out of the hazy air and settle across that surface, gathering in the hollows between the piled plates and greying them further, with a faint cool haze hanging just above the block. THIRD, in the deep zone the fibre bundles are thin, sparse and slack, drooping in loose unsupported curves with wide empty gaps between them and their blue gone pale and dull. FOURTH, wherever a gap sits beneath it the tissue above has nothing to rest on, so the top surface sinks into two or three broad soft-edged furrows that follow the emptiness below exactly.

The stack of rounded cells between them is thinned to a single sparse irregular row, with no bright new cells rising through it. Flat even light with no sparkle anywhere, no hard shadow, shallow depth of field, the far edge dissolving into pale haze. Glossy and immaculate, but quiet and dull.

slots.title: approach · two actives, two destinations, and a surface left whole
slots.prompt:
Soft three-dimensional medical explainer illustration in the style of premium skincare advertising: smooth glossy CGI, luminous and dreamy, high-key on a pale hazy gradient background. Square format.

A block of skin is shown in cross-section, seen from a low three-quarter angle so both its top surface and its cut face are visible, occupying the lower two thirds of the frame. Three strata are legible from top to bottom: a thin outer layer with a fine even texture of neatly interlocking plates; beneath it a stack of two or three rows of flattened rounded translucent cells, the bottom row noticeably larger and rounder than the rest; and below that an open deeper zone filled with long wavy bundles of glossy fibre running horizontally. The tissue is a soft desaturated peach-cream, warm and pale. The fibre bundles are a clear vivid blue, colour hex 014EB1, glassy and translucent against the warm tissue.

FOUR TRANSLUCENT SPHERES OF CLEAR PALE BLUE FLOAT ABOVE THE SURFACE, AND THEY HOLD TWO DIFFERENT THINGS. Two of them each hold a short flat ladder of small pearl-white beads: two straight parallel rows of beads lying side by side and joined by fine short rungs, flat and untwisted like a tiny stepladder seen face-on. The other two each hold a chain of exactly three beads in a row, the outer two pearl-white and the middle one a polished copper bead, colour hex B87333.

From the underside of every sphere a slender shaft of warm white light descends, and THE TWO KINDS REACH DIFFERENT DEPTHS. The shafts from the two ladder spheres stop at the bottom row of the cell stack. The shafts from the two copper-bead spheres pass straight through the cells and continue down into the deep fibre zone.

WHERE EACH SHAFT ARRIVES A BRIGHT STAR-SHAPED GLINT BURSTS. At the bottom cell row the cells there are plump, rounded and lit from within, one of them drawn into a soft figure-of-eight as it divides in two, and a single bright new cell rises upward through the stack above it. In the deep zone, around the copper shafts, the fibre bundles are markedly thicker, denser and more numerous, with several fine bright new strands weaving in among the older ones; further from any shaft they are thinner and duller, the change smooth and gradual.

THE OUTER LAYER IS COMPLETELY WHOLE. Its plates are fine, even and closely fitted across the entire top of the block, unbroken, with nothing lifting, dissolving or coming away. Small bright sparkles drift in the lit zones. Soft diffuse light, no hard shadow, shallow depth of field, the far edge dissolving into pale haze. Glossy, luminous, immaculate.
